column3: MT 83:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “let there be no silence for You” is rendered “do not remain quiet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have lifted the head” is rendered “have exalted themselves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from being a nation” is rendered “as a nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with heart together” is rendered “together with one mind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “an arm” is rendered “a help.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the wadi of Kishon” is rendered “the torrent of Kishon.”
The Hebrew lists all four names for the nobles and princes; NASB pairs “nobles” with Oreb and Zeeb and “princes” with Zebah and Zalmunna.
Close to the Hebrew; “shame” is rendered “dishonor.”
